# Semantic review - glossary baseline

Date: 2026-09-20. Reviewer: domain reviewer (fixture).

## Method

Definition comparison and one scenario walkthrough. No software was used.

## Findings

- Two terms initially conflicted on "model boundary"; resolved in the glossary.
- The review did not test whether teams benefit in practice.

## Limitations

Single reviewer, one scenario, no empirical validation. This review is evidence
for definition consistency at a revision, not proof of user benefit.
